implementation.atomicity: Channel and DM repositories use one INSERT SELECT UPSERT to validate the message belongs to the target, rewind to the preceding message and recompute unread_count from authoritative rows.
implementation.authorization: Channel actions require both view and read permission; DM actions verify participant membership before accessing the anchor.
implementation.client: Desktop context menus and mobile long-press actions call the scoped endpoint and apply the returned count instead of optimistic guessing.
implementation.synchronization: DM mark-unread events include unread_count so the caller's other sessions restore the badge rather than clearing it.

remaining_acceptance: Verify channel and DM counters across two live clients and ensure opening the marked conversation does not immediately clear the restored marker before the intended navigation state is displayed.
